answers.core: It's not possible to implement as an add-on. This would improve the coverage of GDScript as a complete language that is able to refer to all parts of itself such as base classes, types and now the global scope.
answers.workaround: This can technically be worked around by just using longer and/or different names for the functions that share names with any globally defined ones.

title: Ability to reference the @GlobalScope when accessing an identifier or calling a function
